QF.id: SIA Assessment Frameworks Techniques and Standards_11

question.text: GRI standards are organised into three categories. Which statement correctly pairs them?

answer.text: Universal (applicable to all orgs), Sector (40 sectors), Topic (specific topics like health & safety, tax, waste)

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Ch 6, GRI has three categories: (i) Universal Standards — applicable to all organisations, covering concepts, policies and how to use the framework; (ii) Sector Standards — developed for 40 sectors including agriculture, oil & gas; (iii) Topic Standards — specific topics like health & safety, tax, waste management. **The Trap:** Mandatory/Voluntary/Advisory is a generic regulatory layering not used by GRI. Level 1/2/3 is XBRL/GAAP language. Input/Output/Outcome are ToC terms, not GRI structure. **Cross-Exam Context:** III-A Compliance covers disclosure categorisation; XXIII uses GRI as one international framework the SIA may map SE disclosures to under SAS-1100 environmental or SAS-400 gender. **Assessor's Pro-Tip:** When an SE already publishes a GRI report, cross-walk GRI Topic disclosures to your SAS indicators — it avoids duplicate evidence requests and shortens the engagement field time materially.
